verdict.rationale: Docs and a live OpenAPI spec show core memory operations (add, search, container tags, user profiles, memory graph) are fully exposed via the documented, key-gated v3 API, and the docs explicitly separate the consumer UI from API key minting, suggesting an API-first design. However there is no evidence that UI-only features like connector setup (Google Drive/Gmail/Notion/OneDrive/GitHub OAuth sync) or account/dashboard settings are configurable purely through the API. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or confirmation that connector onboarding, billing, and other console-only workflows are also API-reachable, and independent verification of full UI/API parity.
